ball_record_present.description: 1.0 if ball record is present in frame

ball_x_observed.description: 1.0 if ball x coordinate is non-null

ball_y_observed.description: 1.0 if ball y coordinate is non-null

ball_xy_observed.description: 1.0 if both ball x and y coordinates are observed

ball_speed_mps.description: Ball velocity magnitude in metres per second

home_records.description: Count of Home team player records in frame

home_xy_observed.description: Count of Home team players with valid x,y

away_records.description: Count of Away team player records in frame

away_xy_observed.description: Count of Away team players with valid x,y

nearest_home_m.description: Distance to nearest Home team player

nearest_away_m.description: Distance to nearest Away team player

ball_longitudinal_margin_m.description: Distance from ball to nearest touchline/goal line along length

ball_lateral_margin_m.description: Distance from ball to nearest touchline along width

ball_inside_pitch.description: 1.0 if ball is strictly inside pitch boundaries

ball_xy_fraction_1s.description: Fraction of trailing 25 frames with observed ball

ball_xy_age_s.description: Time in seconds since last valid ball observation

nearest_home_median_1s.description: Median nearest home distance over trailing 25 frames

nearest_away_median_1s.description: Median nearest away distance over trailing 25 frames

vis_global_motion.description: Mean absolute intensity difference across downsampled frame

vis_pitch_motion.description: Mean absolute intensity difference inside projected pitch mask

vis_ball_vicinity_motion.description: Motion in 128x128 crop centred on projected ball

vis_ball_crop_std.description: Pixel standard deviation in 64x64 ball crop

vis_ball_white_ratio.description: Ratio of high-luminance white pixels in 64x64 ball crop

vis_home_color_score.description: Jersey color dominance metric for Home team players

vis_away_color_score.description: Jersey color dominance metric for Away team players

vis_player_edge_energy.description: Sobel gradient energy in 128x128 interaction zone
